datasets.name: champion_stats
queryLines:
SELECT
    champion_id,
    champion_name,
    most_picked_lane,
    ROUND(primary_lane_share * 100, 2) AS primary_lane_share,
    global_games_played,
    ROUND(global_pick_rate * 100, 2) AS global_pick_rate,
    ROUND(global_win_rate * 100, 2) AS global_win_rate,
    ROUND(global_ban_rate * 100, 2) AS global_ban_rate
FROM league_records.gold.champion_overviews

datasets.name: match_browser_main
queryLines:
SELECT
  m.match_id,
  m.game_date,
  m.game_duration,
  m.game_version,
  m.winning_team,
  m.average_rank,
  CONCAT_WS(
    ', ',
    COLLECT_LIST(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN p.team = 'BLUE' THEN p.champion_name
      END
    )
  ) AS blue_champions,
  CONCAT_WS(
    ', ',
    COLLECT_LIST(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN p.team = 'RED' THEN p.champion_name
      END
    )
  ) AS red_champions,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN p.team = 'BLUE' THEN p.kills
    END
  ) AS blue_kills,
  MAX(
    CASE
      WHEN p.team = 'RED' THEN p.kills
    END
  ) AS red_kills
FROM
  league_records.silver.matches m
    LEFT JOIN league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats p
      ON m.match_id = p.match_id
GROUP BY
  m.match_id,
  m.game_date,
  m.game_duration,
  m.game_version,
  m.winning_team,
  m.average_rank
ORDER BY
  m.game_date DESC

datasets.name: match_champions_filter
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  champion_name
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats
WHERE
  champion_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  champion_name

datasets.name: match_champions
queryLines:
SELECT DISTINCT
  m.match_id,
  p.champion_name
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_pivot_teamstats m
    JOIN league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats p
      ON m.match_id = p.match_id
WHERE
  p.champion_name IS NOT NULL

datasets.name: match_dossiers
queryLines:
SELECT
  match_id,
  game_date,
  ROUND(game_duration / 60.0, 1) AS game_duration_mins,
  game_version,
  winning_team,
  average_rank,
  blue_kills,
  blue_towers,
  blue_inhibitors,
  blue_dragons,
  blue_void_grubs,
  blue_heralds,
  blue_barons,
  red_kills,
  red_towers,
  red_inhibitors,
  red_dragons,
  red_void_grubs,
  red_heralds,
  red_barons,
  winning_gold_diff
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_pivot_teamstats
ORDER BY
  game_date DESC

datasets.name: pipeline_quality
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Player Stats' AS dataset,
  COUNT(*) AS total_records,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN unlogged_duration > 300 THEN 1
    END
  ) AS stale_records,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN unlogged_duration > 300 THEN 1
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS stale_pct,
  AVG(unlogged_duration) AS avg_unlogged_duration
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Team Stats' AS dataset,
  COUNT(*) AS total_records,
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN unlogged_duration > 300 THEN 1
    END
  ) AS stale_records,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN unlogged_duration > 300 THEN 1
      END
    )
      * 100.0
      / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS stale_pct,
  AVG(unlogged_duration) AS avg_unlogged_duration
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_pivot_teamstats

datasets.name: pipeline_lineage
queryLines:
SELECT
  DATE(event_time) AS activity_date,
  target_table_full_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT entity_run_id) AS update_count
FROM
  system.access.table_lineage
WHERE
  target_table_catalog = 'league_records'
  AND entity_type = 'PIPELINE'
  AND event_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY
  DATE(event_time),
  target_table_full_name
ORDER BY
  activity_date DESC

datasets.name: pipeline_freshness
queryLines:
WITH latest_bronze AS (
  SELECT
    'Bronze' AS layer,
    MAX(game_date) AS latest_date,
    COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM
    league_records.bronze.matches
),
latest_silver AS (
  SELECT
    'Silver' AS layer,
    MAX(game_date) AS latest_date,
    COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM
    league_records.silver.matches
),
latest_gold AS (
  SELECT
    'Gold' AS layer,
    MAX(game_date) AS latest_date,
    COUNT(*) AS match_count
  FROM
    league_records.gold.matchend_pivot_teamstats
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  latest_bronze
UNION ALL
SELECT
  *
FROM
  latest_silver
UNION ALL
SELECT
  *
FROM
  latest_gold

datasets.name: pipeline_volumes
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Bronze Matches' AS table_name,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
  league_records.bronze.matches
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Bronze Intervals' AS table_name,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
  league_records.bronze.intervals
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Silver Matches' AS table_name,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
  league_records.silver.matches
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Gold Player Stats' AS table_name,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
  league_records.gold.matchend_player_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Gold Champion Stats' AS table_name,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
  league_records.gold.champion_overviews
